svg.title: ArtViSiON — L / BRANDiNG: the logo, built on geometry then installed
svg.desc: Left: the construction sheet — base circle, the mark's two discs and their lens, axis guides with node squares, guide circles, arcs drawing on, the compass. Right: the mark installed — ACP-clad fascia, a totem pylon on the pavement and a fitter on the ladder. Animated. Editable layers: background, artwork, logo.
